name: Natural Questions (NQ)
description: Natural Questions is a large-scale QA dataset designed to mimic realistic user information-seeking behavior. It consists of queries submitted to Google search engine paired with corresponding Wikipedia pages and human-annotated long answers (entire paragraphs) and short answers (concise spans).
